meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes before a client call, so tell me why my son's essay has a zero in the gradebook.
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Why does Owen's essay have a zero, and who decided that?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, Hale, or tell me what you have that justifies it.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why did my son find out about this from a gradebook on his phone? Nobody called me, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn and that I receive an apology for how he found out. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her opening position, with nothing agreed, since no evidence was shown and she never moved off the zero coming off.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "tell me how I should handle this", because asking her how to do your job made her respect you less and pushed you no closer to an answer on the zero.
Try next time: when she first asked why the zero was in the gradebook and who decided, answer that question directly by owning that it went in before you called her, then show any dated document you have.
